answer.rationale: Competitive price pressure on SMB base requires immediate response. Memory_73 confirms promotional pricing drives acquisition and revenue lift in price-sensitive SMB segments—directly applicable to current churn threat. A small guarded test (limited duration, capped discount depth, subset of at-risk cohort) allows rapid deployment without committing to broad margin erosion. This preserves optionality: if churn stabilizes, pricing reverts; if needed, learnings inform broader strategy. Risk: promotional pricing can damage LTV and anchor expectations downward, eroding long-term qualified revenue. Mitigation: pair with memory_86 (onboarding shortening) and memory_91 (activation messaging) in follow-on phases to maximize retention and reduce customer acquisition cost. Referral incentives (memory_57) and enterprise sales assist (memory_44) address different segments and do not address immediate SMB churn. Activation messaging alone cannot counter direct price competition. Guarded scale limits downside while generating signal for next week's verification cycle.
